context: An intern profiles a corporate event
purpose: Teach: エクセル/シャンパン/猛暑/バスケ/棚田/日の出/レプリカ/特訓

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 蓮です。発表会、エクセル資料、確認できますか。
lines.en: Ren here. Can you verify the Excel materials for the presentation?
lines.style: Gentle opening. Respectful but not stiff. Soft attack on the question. Quiet concern underneath — genuinely wants confirmation, not just procedure.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: うん。乾杯はシャンパンで、社員にもふるまう。
lines.en: Yes. We'll toast with champagne and treat the staff as well.
lines.style: Assured and steady. Light affirmation on the opening word. Measured pace that signals confidence in the plan. Matter-of-fact warmth — not showy, just decided.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 今年の猛暑対策、会場での対応もありますか。
lines.en: And with this year's heat — are there measures at the venue itself?
lines.style: Thoughtful check-in. Slight hesitation on the opening phrase, as if running through a mental checklist. Attentive tone, searching for gaps. Small uptick at the end — genuinely asking, not doubting.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: うん。バスケットコート併設の会場で、休憩エリア、設計済み。
lines.en: Yes. We've already designed a break area at the basketball-court venue.
lines.style: Clear, directional. Confident tempo. Brief declarative sentences. The tone of someone who has already walked through the logistics and is reporting back with assurance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: プロモ動画、棚田や日の出のロケ、入っていますね。
lines.en: The promo video includes the rice-terrace and sunrise location shots, right?
lines.style: Earnest confirmation-seeking. Slight lift on the name of the location details — he's engaged with this. Soft rise at the end, inviting agreement. Careful, not doubtful.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: うん。陶磁器のレプリカ、展示する。
lines.style: Crisp, affirming. Light brightness in the delivery — this detail matters. Brief and settled. A small nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: プレゼン特訓、何度も繰り返したいです。
lines.en: I'd like to run through the presentation drills many more times.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Gentle but unmistakable resolve. Slight lean forward in the delivery. Not anxious — purposeful. Trails slightly at the end with commitment, not doubt.
